---
title: "About"
---

The **Democracy and Political Violence Conference & Working Group** convenes researchers
working on political violence and (anti-)democratic attitudes. The conference is held at
Harvard University in Cambridge, MA.

## Organizers

The conference is organized by **Sam**, **Gal**, and **Jack**.

## Questions, comments, concerns

Have a question, or want to share information or feedback? Please reach out to the
organizers.
